mu_name_from: MODEL_DAYBREAK (MODEL_SWORD + 24), loaded from Item/CW_Sword.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1101). Ours is named Sword25 by the index-plus-one rule the other swords keep; MU never loads a Sword25 file. Group 0 number 24 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:161.
why_this_one: The 100-140 weapons MU has and this game lacked (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's); the first four, one a class, lowest first.

stats.call_note: The Season 6 CreateWeapon: group, number, slot, skill, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strength, agility, energy, vitality, then darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel.
stats.class_level_note: The Blade Knight's alone: OpenMU's darkKnightClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

stance_from: Width 2: MuMain's ItemAttribute TwoHand, PLAYER_STOP_TWO_HAND_SWORD, as the Dark Breaker.
sheet_from: Data/Item/dn3_darksw.OZJ (64x128, a dark steel blade with a violet-grey edge, mesh 0, 242 triangles) and Thunder01 (64x64, a blue-white flare on black, mesh 1, 12 triangles: crossed cards), decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_overrides_note: As every broad flat blade passed in the studio: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the grass black.
glow_note: MuMain has no RenderPartObjectBody arm for MODEL_DAYBREAK; its Thunder01 cards are a black-backed flare, drawn added here as every such card. PartObjectColor2 gives it Color 24 (ZzzObject.cpp:6636).
